statusLegend.Pass: Manually executed this cycle and matching the expected result
statusLegend.TBC: Onboarded and documented, not yet executed or not yet conclusive
statusLegend.Clarification Needed: Cannot be executed until product behaviour is clarified

1.label: Automatable now
1.description: Validated entirely in Outlook Web against a policy that already exists in the tenant.

2.label: Needs SPO/ODB UI work
2.description: Same pattern as the shipped test but requires SharePoint or OneDrive file automation.

3.label: Needs Purview portal work
3.description: Requires policy lifecycle actions or reading Purview report surfaces.

4.label: Manual for now
4.description: Not reliably automatable as written today.

cases.name: Apply Label Enforcement – SIT in SPO
cases.description: Verify enforcement policy applies label to files with Credit Card SIT in SharePoint
cases.automationNote: Needs SharePoint web UI automation: upload the SIT file, wait for enforcement, read the file label.

cases.name: Apply Label Enforcement – SIT in ODB
cases.description: Verify enforcement policy applies label to files with Credit Card SIT in OneDrive for Business
cases.automationNote: Needs OneDrive web UI automation: upload the SIT file, wait for enforcement, read the file label.

cases.name: Apply Label Enforcement – SIT in EXO
cases.description: Verify enforcement policy labels emails with Credit Card SIT in Exchange Online
cases.automationNote: Shipped. Automated end-to-end and passing against the tenant using SingleLocationScope-Enforcement-SIT to EnforcementTest-Label.

cases.name: Apply Label Enforcement – All Workloads
cases.description: Verify enforcement scoped to SPO + ODB + EXO simultaneously
cases.automationNote: Multi-workload. The EXO leg is coverable with the current harness today; SPO and ODB legs need file-upload automation.

cases.name: Apply Label Enforcement – Multiple SIT Types
cases.description: Verify policy with multiple SITs (Credit Card OR SSN)
cases.automationNote: Identical in shape to TC-003 but scoped to SPO and ODB, so it needs file-upload automation.

cases.name: Override Label – SPO
cases.description: Verify OverwriteLabel replaces an existing lower-priority label on SPO files
cases.automationNote: Needs pre-labelled SharePoint files plus a label read after enforcement.

cases.name: Override Label – ODB
cases.description: Verify OverwriteLabel replaces an existing lower-priority label on ODB files
cases.automationNote: Needs pre-labelled OneDrive files plus a label read after enforcement.

cases.name: Override Label – Without Override Enabled
cases.description: Verify that WITHOUT OverwriteLabel, existing labels are preserved
cases.automationNote: Negative override. Needs pre-labelled files and an assertion that the label did not change.

cases.name: Override Label – EXO (Email)
cases.description: Verify OverwriteLabel works for Exchange Online emails
cases.automationNote: Next best candidate. Same harness plus one pre-labelled draft; the OverrideLabel-SIT policy already exists in the tenant.

cases.name: Remove Label – SPO
cases.description: Verify auto-labeling Remove Label mode removes a specific label from SPO files
cases.automationNote: Remove-label verification on SharePoint files; needs file upload plus label reads.

cases.name: Remove Label – ODB
cases.description: Verify Remove Label mode removes a specific label from ODB files
cases.automationNote: Remove-label verification on OneDrive files; needs file upload plus label reads.

cases.name: Remove Label – Negative (No label to remove)
cases.description: Verify Remove Label does not error on files that do not have the target label
cases.automationNote: Negative remove-label on unlabelled SPO and ODB files; assertion is that nothing changed.

cases.name: Simulation – SIT Detection SPO/ODB
cases.description: Verify simulation mode detects SIT matches without applying labels
cases.automationNote: Verification lives on the Purview simulation overview page, not in the workload UI.

cases.name: Simulation – SIT Detection EXO
cases.description: Verify simulation detects SIT matches in Exchange Online
cases.automationNote: Email side is easy to trigger, but the assertion is on the Purview simulation overview page.

cases.name: Simulation to Enforcement Transition
cases.description: Verify turning on a simulation policy transitions to enforcement and applies labels
cases.automationNote: Requires switching a policy from simulation to enforcement, which mutates policy state.

cases.name: Simulation – Restart Simulation
cases.description: Verify restarting simulation re-scans content
cases.automationNote: Requires restarting a simulation from the Purview portal.

cases.name: Simulation – Auto-Enable After (Scheduled Enforcement)
cases.description: Verify AutoEnableAfter schedules automatic transition to enforcement
cases.automationNote: Requires configuring scheduled auto-enable on a policy in the portal.

cases.name: Negative – No SIT Match
cases.description: Verify files without SIT data are NOT labeled
cases.automationNote: The EXO leg needs only a send with no SIT plus a negative label assertion; the SPO and ODB legs need Tier 2 work.

cases.name: Edge Case – Multiple File Types
cases.description: Verify auto-labeling across .docx, .xlsx, .pptx, .pdf
cases.automationNote: Same flow repeated across docx, xlsx, pdf and pptx; cheap to add once Tier 2 exists.

cases.name: Edge Case – Large File (>10 MB)
cases.description: Verify auto-labeling processes large files
cases.automationNote: Large-file upload timing. Feasible but slow, and mostly a performance observation.

cases.name: Edge Case – Failed Labeling
cases.description: Verify failed labeling events are captured correctly
cases.automationNote: Requires deliberately inducing a labeling failure such as a locked or checked-out file, which is hard to trigger reliably.

cases.name: Policy Disable / Enable
cases.description: Verify disabling and re-enabling a policy
cases.automationNote: Policy lifecycle action. Mutating policy state conflicts with the read-only weekly model.

cases.name: Policy Edit – Modify Conditions
cases.description: Verify editing policy conditions takes effect
cases.automationNote: Policy lifecycle action, as above.

cases.name: Policy Deletion
cases.description: Verify test policies can be deleted cleanly
cases.automationNote: Policy lifecycle action, as above.
